event.title: Protests Erupt in India Demanding Resignation of Election Chief
event.canonical_title: Protests Erupt in India Demanding Resignation of Election Chief
event.summary: A youth group known as the 'Cockroach' movement has threatened to resume mass protests unless Gyanesh Kumar resigns as head of India's election commission. This demand follows allegations of election rigging, which have also prompted opposition parties, including Congress, to join the protests. Police have responded with tear gas to disperse demonstrators.

timeline.title: Mass Protests Erupt in Madrid Over Housing Crisis Following Elderly Woman's Eviction
timeline.summary: Tens of thousands of people protested in Madrid against Spain's housing crisis after the eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her home of over 70 years. The incident has sparked widespread anger and calls for government action to address rising housing costs and prevent further evictions.

timeline.title: Protests Erupt in France as Students and Workers Clash with Police Over Budget Cuts
timeline.summary: Protests in France have escalated as students and public workers demonstrate against planned budget cuts. Clashes with police have resulted in over 200 arrests and multiple injuries. Students are particularly protesting against class sizes, teacher shortages, and long timetables, leading to school blockades that have spread across the country.

More than 200 arrests reported.
Protests have spread across France from Paris.

timeline.summary: Student protests in France have escalated, resulting in violent clashes and widespread unrest. The situation has led to school blockades and numerous injuries among protesters and law enforcement.

timeline.title: Protests Erupt in Spain as Parliament Rejects Housing Crisis Measures
timeline.summary: Protests erupted across Spain ahead of a parliamentary vote on housing measures, following the eviction of an 87-year-old woman that sparked public outrage. Hundreds demonstrated in Madrid and other cities, expressing their discontent with the government's handling of the housing crisis. The proposed measures were ultimately rejected by opposition lawmakers, intensifying pressure on the government and raising speculation about a potential snap election.
key_facts: Protests occurred in Madrid and other cities.
Demonstrators expressed outrage over housing issues.
Parliament rejected housing measures proposed by the government.
